info.title: TechPulse AI API
info.description: Canonical HTTP contract for the Vietnamese-first TechPulse AI MVP. External content is untrusted data; no response contains source full text or media binary.

get.summary: Check API process health without exposing dependency details

post.summary: Request deletion of the current account

get.summary: List the current user's saved articles

delete.summary: Delete the current user's saved-article history

get.summary: List the current user's chat sessions

delete.summary: Delete all chat sessions owned by the current user

204.description: Chat session deleted or already absent

get.summary: Get one visible article with source citation
Search visible articles using text or hybrid retrieval

post.summary: Answer from retrieved evidence with paragraph citations

patch.summary: Update source configuration or operational state

Trigger bounded ingestion using the shared job service
Cancel a queued job or request safe stop
Regenerate a summary under current source policy
Merge duplicate records while preserving provenance
Record a takedown or privacy request

Suspend or restore a user and revoke sessions as required

202.description: Daily run accepted and bounded work attempted

cronBearer.description: Vercel CRON_SECRET; never accepted from a browser session.

CursorQuery.name: cursor
CursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor; clients must not parse it.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permission or invalid CSRF token

error.message: Insufficient permission or invalid CSRF token

Conflict.description: State, duplicate, lease, or idempotency conflict

error.message: State, duplicate, lease, or idempotency conflict

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry may succeed

csrfToken.description: Send in X-CSRF-Token for state-changing session-authenticated requests.

LeadMedia.description: Remote media metadata only. Images may use remote-preview when source policy permits; video is link-only in the MVP. Binary media is never returned or stored by TechPulse AI.

AnswerScope.description: At least one of articleId, topics, or a time-bounded topic query must be supplied.

Answer.description: answered requires non-empty paragraphs/citations; refused requires empty paragraphs and a refusalReason. Citation URLs are resolved by the server, never accepted from the model.

MediaPolicy.description: Display permission is independent from text storage and LLM input rights. The MVP never downloads or rehosts source media.

mediaPolicy.description: Optional on draft creation; the server defaults to imageMode=none, videoMode=none and an empty host allowlist.

SourceUpdateRequest.description: At least one mutable field besides reason is required. Activating a source is rejected unless technical and policy preconditions pass.

PolicyReviewRequest.description: If rights are unclear, choose metadata-only. Technical check or AI output cannot approve this review.

AdminArticleUpdateRequest.description: At least one of status, topics or leadMediaStatus is required. Restoring media requires a current source policy that still permits its mode and host. Removed article restoration is subject to takedown policy.

TakedownUpdateRequest.description: Only transitions allowed by the PRD state machine are accepted. Completing requires all approved cleanup checks.
